scope: Independent check of exactly four proposed corrections; linguistic acceptance only

decisions.source: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
decisions.final: Útflutningi lokið: %1$s. Teikningin þín í heild inniheldur enn óvistaðar breytingar; vistaðu afrit af allri myndinni áður en þú skiptir henni út.
decisions.reason: Útflutningi is dative in the impersonal completion construction (útflutningi [er] lokið); lokið does not predicate a gender of %1$s. Colon-label punctuation is appropriate for a result notice. Teikningin þín í heild explicitly covers the drawing as a whole; enn óvistaðar breytingar retains ongoing unsaved changes. The imperative vistaðu requires saving afrit af allri myndinni, a copy of the entire image. Áður en orders this before replacement; henni matches feminine mynd/teikning, not neuter afrit. No export-equals-full-save implication.

Aðal- plus hluti forms a complete noun meaning main part/section and is suitable for the supplied generic section-caption context adjacent to Drawing/Color. It adds neither palette nor screen/menu specificity. Acceptance is an idiomatic explicit-section choice, not proof that every compact Aðal caption is ungrammatical: UI clipping can be intentional. The longer caption has not been layout-tested.

decisions.source: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
decisions.final: הייצוא של %1$s הושלם. בציור המלא שלך עדיין יש שינויים שלא נשמרו; לפני החלפתו, יש לשמור עותק של התמונה המלאה.
decisions.reason: הייצוא is the explicit masculine singular subject; הושלם is its completed passive predicate. של links the opaque label without requiring that label to have masculine gender. בציור המלא שלך locates the changes in the full drawing; עדיין plus שלא נשמרו preserves the still-unsaved state. לפני החלפתו refers back to masculine ציור (before its replacement); יש לשמור expresses the requirement to save עותק של התמונה המלאה, a copy of the complete image. The warning does not claim export saved the full drawing. Original periods, comma and semicolon remain.

decisions.source: %1$s exported. Your full drawing still has unsaved changes; save a full image copy before replacing it.
decisions.final: %1$s کی برآمد مکمل ہو گئی۔ آپ کی مکمل ڈرائنگ میں اب بھی ایسی تبدیلیاں ہیں جو محفوظ نہیں کی گئیں؛ اسے بدلنے سے پہلے مکمل تصویر کی ایک نقل محفوظ کریں۔
decisions.reason: In %1$s کی برآمد, کی agrees with feminine برآمد, not the opaque preceding token; مکمل ہو گئی likewise agrees with that explicit export noun and states completion. آپ کی مکمل ڈرائنگ retains the complete drawing; اب بھی and تبدیلیاں ... محفوظ نہیں کی گئیں retain still-unsaved changes, with feminine plural passive agreement to تبدیلیاں. اسے refers to the drawing in the warning; بدلنے سے پہلے plus محفوظ کریں requires saving before replacing it. مکمل تصویر کی ایک نقل requests a copy of the complete image, not merely a derivative export. Urdu full stops U+06D4 and semicolon U+061B are preserved.

limits: Independent model linguistic judgment, not native-human certification; reasoning uses grammar and source meaning, not backtranslation alone.
No production changes, application tests, rendered UI/RTL/bidi checks or full-language certification.
No published matching sentence or consumer discovery required for acceptance.
